h: Soludo reportedly says APGA will not automatically back Obi in 2027, urges Igbo unity and wider alliances
p: Anambra Governor Chukwuma Soludo has reportedly said his party, APGA, will not automatically throw its weight behind Peter Obi's 2027 bid. He is said to have called for Igbo unity and broader political alliances instead.
more: Some Igbo groups have already rejected moves by Soludo and APGA to endorse President Tinubu.
Obi's camp has not yet responded in detail.
